title: Go Concurrency Workshop
overview: A deep-dive workshop into Go concurrency patterns, goroutines, channels, and select statements.
description:
A hands-on workshop that takes you from the fundamentals of Go concurrency to the advanced patterns used in production systems.

You'll build real-world examples using goroutines and channels, explore select statements for synchronization, and learn how to avoid common pitfalls like deadlocks and race conditions.

By the end of the day, you'll be able to design safe, efficient concurrent programs in Go.

discussions.message: Super excited for this one — will there be any live coding exercises?
Yes! The afternoon session is entirely hands-on. Bring your laptop with Go 1.22+ installed.

title: Frontend Craft Conference
overview: Building scalable interfaces with modern web standards, React, and performance optimizations.
description:
A full-day conference for frontend engineers who want to level up how they build and ship web applications.

Talks and hands-on labs will cover modern web standards, React architecture, and performance optimization techniques that hold up at scale.

You'll leave with practical patterns and tooling recommendations you can apply to your own codebase immediately.

discussions.message: Any recommendations for state management libraries in large-scale React apps recently?
We've been happy with Zustand + TanStack Query for most cases.

title: Kubernetes & Cloud Native Workshop
overview: Mastering container orchestration, microservices deployment, and cluster management.
description:
A practical workshop on running production workloads with Kubernetes and cloud-native tooling.

We'll cover container orchestration fundamentals, deploying microservices, and managing clusters with confidence.

Expect live demos on autoscaling, observability, and common operational gotchas.

discussions.message: We will discuss cluster autoscaling strategies on our next meetup next week.
Looking forward to it! Please cover Karpenter vs Cluster Autoscaler.

title: UI/UX Design Systems Scale-Up
overview: How to build, maintain, and scale design systems across cross-functional product teams.
description:
A session for product designers and engineers building design systems that need to scale.

We'll walk through establishing, maintaining, and evolving a design system across multiple product teams.

The second half is an open critique where you can get feedback on your own components and case studies.

discussions.message: Don't forget to submit your case studies for the upcoming design critique session!
Submitted mine. Excited to get feedback!

title: Data Engineering & Pipeline Architecture
overview: Designing robust ETL pipelines, data lakes, and real-time streaming with Apache Kafka.
description:
A deep dive into the architecture behind reliable, scalable data platforms.

We'll cover ETL pipeline design, data lake patterns, and real-time streaming with Apache Kafka.

You'll learn how to reason about trade-offs in latency, throughput, and cost when designing data infrastructure.

discussions.message: Which streaming platform do you prefer: Kafka or Flink?
Depends on the use case — Kafka for ingestion, Flink for stateful processing.

title: Cybersecurity Fundamentals for Devs
overview: Protecting web apps against OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, secure coding practices, and auditing.
description:
A security-focused workshop built for developers, not just security specialists.

We'll go through the OWASP Top 10 with live demos against deliberately vulnerable applications.

You'll learn secure coding practices and auditing techniques you can apply to your own services right away.

discussions.message: We'll cover OWASP Top 10 with live demos on vulnerable apps.
Great, will there be a hands-on lab?

title: Real-Time Streaming with Kafka & Flink
overview: Hands-on session building real-time data pipelines with Apache Kafka and Flink for production workloads.
description:
A hands-on session on building production-grade real-time data pipelines.

We'll spin up a local cluster and build streaming jobs with Apache Kafka and Flink from scratch.

By the end you'll understand when to reach for each tool and how to operate streaming pipelines reliably.

discussions.message: Bring your own machine — we'll spin up a local Kafka cluster.
Slides and repo will be shared after the session.

title: Capture The Flag Competition
overview: A full-day CTF covering web exploitation, reverse engineering, and cryptography challenges for all levels.
description:
A full-day capture-the-flag competition open to teams of up to three.

Challenges span web exploitation, reverse engineering, and cryptography, with tiers for beginners through advanced players.

The top three teams win prizes, and every participant leaves with a clearer picture of offensive security techniques.

discussions.message: Registration for the upcoming CTF competition is now open!
Teams of up to 3 — who wants to join mine?

title: Intro to LLMs & RAG
overview: An introduction to large language models and retrieval-augmented generation, with live demos.
description:
A beginner-friendly introduction to large language models and retrieval-augmented generation.

We'll explain how LLMs work, why they hallucinate, and how RAG grounds them in your own data.

Expect live demos building a working RAG pipeline, plus pointers for fine-tuning open-weight models for Indonesian text.

discussions.message: Anyone tried fine-tuning open-weight models for Indonesian text?
We'll demo a RAG pipeline with Qdrant in the workshop.

title: Flutter Performance Tuning
overview: Practical techniques to profile and optimize Flutter apps, from jank to 60fps.
description:
A hands-on workshop for Flutter developers chasing smooth 60fps experiences.

We'll profile real apps, identify jank, and apply concrete optimizations using the latest tooling.

Topics include Impeller rendering, widget rebuilds, and memory optimizations you can ship immediately.

discussions.message: Flutter 3.24 brings new performance tooling — let's discuss it in the next meetup.
Can we also cover Impeller rendering optimizations?
